feeding_claim.verbatim: Our beef never receive Vaccines, antibiotics, hormones, or grain of any kind.

notes: Family farm in Albion, near Wolf Lake, in Noble County. Checked the homepage, about us, beef store, pickup locations and contact pages. The site headline is 100% Grass Fed and Finished Local Beef, and the about page says the cattle get no grain of any kind, graze pasture and get hay in winter. Online orders are picked up at a chosen time and location and paid at pickup. Whole beef is $5 per lb and half beef $5.50 per lb hanging weight, processed at Cedar Creek Meats (Laotto), Pork N' Cleaver (Albion) or Integrity Meats (Churubusco). The about page says the farm started at a farmers market in spring 2024 but does not name it. The pickup locations page loads no locations and the beef store showed no products when checked, so pickup points could not be recorded. Address and phone are from the contact page.
